label: r4c2
name: Landing-gated + layout/flip/type gates
hypothesis: The hidden change may reorder the flat action index, for example anchor-major instead of type-major, or transposed y and x. Zero-initialised scalar gates add three alternative flattening orders, three grid flips and a type-mixing matrix to the landing-gated logits. Each gate is shared across all actions, so it learns fast if one matches the true layout. Refuted if training success stays at 0.
